# Vendored complexitylib sources

This directory holds 197 Lean source files of complexitylib
(`SamuelSchlesinger/complexitylib` at `d29dc5d8d97de36b7425ded7fd046931a4b6d9fb`),
the part of the library imported by this repository: polynomial-time functions and
languages on deterministic multi-tape Turing machines (`Complexity.FP`,
`Complexity.P`), canonical encodings, the tools used to prove membership in
`Complexity.FP`, and the deterministic time hierarchy theorem. They form the
`Complexitylib` library of this repository's Lake package (`srcDir = "vendor/complexitylib"` in
`lakefile.toml`); the module names are unchanged.

All files are unchanged.

`UPSTREAM_SOURCES.json` records every file with its upstream SHA-256 hash;
`verify_bundle.py` checks them.
